Audit complete — read-only; no writes, no Python/Node execution, FIFO touched only via `ls`/`stat` metadata (never opened). Tooling note: this turn exposes no subagent-spawn API, so I ran the audit directly with batched read-only commands (the two listed agents are from the prior round with no send/close API here). LINE foreground is **not** needed for this round; it stays local and read-only.

RUNROOT: `harness-development/line-v3-live-e2e-20261010/continuations/scope-recovery-05/recovery-02` (all relative paths below resolve there).

**Verdict**
- `check-specs.json` (sha256 `5bd52c11c232fecee06b6edb83b009ea49fcb1378459a5653f31310bb8b59d4c`) is internally consistent and matches `plan.md`/`handoff.md` intent: check set, order, argv, cwd, env, timeouts, evidence stems, allowed-runner ids, and stop/retry policy all align. No BLOCKER found. Findings below are NOTEs (plus one declared-vs-implemented guard gap).

**C1 — check objects (all 5, lines 29–180)**
- `baseline-selftest-02` (check-specs.json:30–57): HOST_ABSOLUTE_CAPTURE, `python3.13 -B …/checks/test_inventory.py`, requires `[]`, product_attempt `false`, cwd=ROOT, 60 s, stem `evidence/baseline-selftest-02`, source_hashes `{tools/inventory.py, checks/test_inventory.py, checks/compare_inventories.py}` all null. Matches plan.md:71 and plan.md:59 (host selftest of fixture-based tool + compare binding). Null bindings are expected (freeze written later); current on-disk values are recorded for the implementer: `tools/inventory.py` `7c4a749c…` (22374 B), `checks/test_inventory.py` `9518e419…` (17168 B), `checks/compare_inventories.py` `cbee9e07…` (19215 B).
- `runner-preflight-01` (:59–87): HOST, `python3.13 -B …/checks/run_command.py --preflight`, requires `[]`, false, stem `evidence/runner-preflight-01`, hashes `{checks/run_command.py, check-specs.json, check-specs-freeze.json}` null. Matches plan.md:63/72; run_command enforces "no writes/no child" (run_command.py:435–447; test case `preflight_no_writes_ok` test_run_command.py:117–132).
- `runner-selftest-01` (:89–119): HOST, `python3.13 -B …/checks/test_run_command.py`, requires `[runner-preflight-01]`, false, stem `evidence/runner-selftest-01`, hashes incl. `checks/test_run_command.py` null. Matches plan.md:73; gate consumes JSON `pass:true` + `run_command_sha256` binding (gate_receipts.py:451–458).
- `node-adapter-syntax-02` (:121–148): VERIFIED_RUNROOT_RUNNER, `node --check scripts/line_backup_cua_adapter.mjs`, requires `[runner-selftest-01]`, product_attempt `true`, hash `scripts/line_backup_cua_adapter.mjs = bf83dd93…`. On-disk file matches exactly (`bf83dd93e8fd53ace40d6a65f09bcfa9bf31ffa0fbfff92dfb2e8f43459026d2`, 39953 B). Matches plan.md:74/87.
- `node-adapter-tests-01` (:149–180): VERIFIED runner, `node --test tests/test_cua_adapter.mjs <RUNROOT>/checks/test_capture_regression.mjs`, requires `[node-adapter-syntax-02]`, product_attempt `true`, hashes: adapter `bf83dd93…` ✓ on disk, `tests/test_cua_adapter.mjs = 0bb0d996…` ✓ on disk (`0bb0d99636f35150272fc952b6efa84261e1e9c68375225787221b8b389662bd`, 18529 B), `checks/test_capture_regression.mjs` null (current disk `dc45d7e7…`, 10808 B). Matches plan.md:75/87; RUNREL expansion rule plan.md:75.
- Non-null source binds verified on disk; all null binds are post-freeze resolutions. Executables block (:12–27) verified on disk: python `34af8eed…`/52640 B ✓, node `1ef99ea2…`/50320 B ✓; contract block (:7–11) `057145c1…`/2811 B ✓.
- Confirmed reading: inventory runs (baseline/preservation) are **not** check objects but covered by the `baseline_inventory` block (:196–211); compares and gate invocations are host orchestration (`checks/compare_inventories.py` modes line 54; `tools/gate_receipts.py` outputs :85–90), matching plan.md:59/89/104–110 and handoff.md:63–72.

**C2 — plan.md:57/59/89 and stop rules**
- plan.md:59 order (anchor → materialize → host selftest → two inventories → historical/bootstrap compare → `g-baseline-recovery-02.json`) matches check order and gate consumption (gate_receipts.py:315–355). plan.md:57 historical projections are implemented (compare_inventories.py:295–357; covered fields fail on mismatch, uncovered = coverage-gap informational). plan.md:89 preservation is implemented in `g_preservation` (gate_receipts.py:504–543, incl. backups, incidents, planned-additions tail).
- No check-id/argv contradicts plan.md:69–75. Stop policy aligned: `first_failure: STOP_DEPENDENT_CHECKS_AND_REPORT_NO_PRODUCT_FIX` (:190), `automatic_retry:false` top-level (:185) and per-check, requires chains encode dependencies.
- `[NOTE-5]` Both node checks carry `product_attempt:true`; consistent with the single remaining product set = one syntax + one suite (plan.md:87/116, handoff.md:70), but the attempt ledger must record **one** consumption at the first Node launch (plan.md:116) — not two.
- `[NOTE-6]` `requires` does not encode the G_RUNNER gate itself (syntax only requires runner-selftest-01); the gate is enforced via `g-runner.json`/`g-adapter` receipts (gate_receipts.py:404–459, 462–501). Consistent with plan, worth knowing.

**C3 — status / source_binding / runner_allowed / baseline_inventory**
- `status: NOT_RUN` (:212) + per-check NOT_RUN + `native_harness_validation: NOT_RUN` (:213) match handoff.md:9/90/94.
- `runner_allowed_check_ids` = exactly the two node checks (:186–189) — matches handoff.md:70 and plan.md:77.
- `baseline_inventory` (:196–211): deadline 1200 s, four outputs, FIFO allowlist string identical to plan.md:52 and `tools/inventory.py:43–47` (resolved ROOT-relative; actual object verified: type=Fifo, ino=124270681, mode prw-r--r--, size 0, nlink=1 — at `evidence/20260916-auto-verification/…/destination/special.fifo` under ROOT), `automatic_retry:false`, `timeout_action: KEEP_PARTIAL_STOP_NO_RERUN` — matches handoff.md:78 and plan.md:77–78.
- `[NOTE-1]` `source_binding.rule` (:194) says every null must resolve from the freeze "at launch", but `baseline-selftest-02` launches pre-freeze (freeze `written_when` is AFTER_G_BASELINE_PASS, :193). Enforced reality: only run_command-mediated launches resolve/refuse on the freeze (run_command.py:183–201); the selftest's bindings are checked at gate time against live disk (gate_receipts.py:327–340). No conflict in the frozen order.
- `[NOTE-2]` Neither plan.md nor handoff.md names `check-specs-freeze.json` (only check-specs.json:83/115/192–195 and the tools). Its required schema (`resolved_source_hashes`, `self_reference.excluded_relative_path`, identity fields) is defined only by run_command.py:183–201 and gate_receipts.py:424–441.
- `[NOTE-4]` Relative-root mix inside check-specs: `baseline_inventory.outputs` are RUNROOT-relative while `fifo_allowlist` is ROOT-relative; plan.md:9's rule ("relative = ROOT unless stated RUNROOT 內") resolves it, and the tools implement it that way.

**C4 — handoff prompt vs check-specs**
- Receiving prompt = handoff.md:1 (single long paragraph; read-only freeze, no contract/tool writes before anchor, materialize contract from block, FIFO lstat-only, runner after baseline PASS, one Node syntax + one suite, first-failure stop, NOT_RUN native).
- Ordered steps = handoff.md:65–72: (1) LOAD/read-only freeze → (2) anchor → materialize plan-contract.json/handoff.json → (3) inventory fixtures + host selftest → (4) G_BASELINE → (5) G_RUNNER preflight/selftest → (6) G_ADAPTER (syntax once, then tests once) → (7) G_PRESERVE → (8) G_REPORT/submission. Every check-bearing step maps 1:1 to the five check objects in the same order; no ordering inconsistency vs plan.md:77.
- Freeze timing (check-specs `AFTER_G_BASELINE_PASS_BEFORE_HOST_PREFLIGHT`) fits plan.md:77 (baseline → G_BASELINE → preflight) and handoff.md:68–69. Dry-run: neither plan.md nor handoff.md mandates dry-run-first; `--dry-run` is observation-only in gate_receipts.py:549–552/219–221 — the dry-run-first sequence is orchestration choice, not a plan requirement; nothing contradicts.

**C5 — cross-file hash audit (all match on disk)**
- `plan.md` 21887 B / `6604529c…` ✓ (refs: handoff.md:7, gate_receipts.py:52).
- `handoff.md` 18692 B / `fa076f67…` ✓ (ref: gate_receipts.py:53).

- Bootstrap v2 `evidence/bootstrap-prewrite-runroot-v2.json` 26694 B / `4e067bac…` ✓ (refs: gate_receipts.py:55/321). Bootstrap v1 `evidence/bootstrap-prewrite-runroot.json` 41083592 B / `bc3be825…` ✓ (refs: v2 `supersedes` block lines 6–10; only size pinned at gate_receipts.py:56 — v1 is correctly **not** in check-specs.json/gate refs).
- Bonus spot-checks (all ✓): historic manifest `b115df6e…`, historic status `67f78557…`, 4 incident receipts at `continuations/evidence/node-adapter-syntax-01.*` (`e6af5795…`/303, `e1d16b37…`/678, `e3b0c442…`/0, `8948d951…`/318), old FAIL pair (`b8837c5d…`/142531, `c0ce0019…`/1680), state/config/ledger (`45505011…`, `5e4f769d…`, `92bab0cf…`). `check-specs-freeze.json` correctly absent.

**Residual finding (cross-file, not a check-specs contradiction)**
- `[NOTE-3]` run_command.py:9–10 declares "CHECK_ID must be one of `runner_allowed_check_ids`", but `run_check` enforces only: id must exist in `checks`, argv must equal frozen argv, and fixed runtime for VERIFIED launcher (checks/run_command.py:313–347); there is no membership test against `runner_allowed_check_ids` (that list is only echoed in preflight, :232/247). In the official order this is benign (host receipts exist by the time the runner exists, so ID-collision refusal at :343–345 blocks reuse), but the docstring overstates enforcement. Suggested follow-up for the implementer: align docstring or add the guard — before the official run, since it changes an existing file and post-b1 edits are frozen.

No files were modified; all commands were static reads (`rg/sed/cat/shasum/stat/ls`).
